title: Settings
branding.title: Branding
branding.body: The colour your team sees across the product.
branding.sidebar.LightHint: White panel, dark text. The product default.
branding.sidebar.DarkHint: A fixed dark panel. This is not dark mode — the rest of the product stays light.
branding.sidebar.BrandHint: Your brand colour as the panel, with the text colour computed for it.
branding.loadFailed: Could not load the branding settings.
branding.forbidden: Only a manager can change the branding.
branding.conflict: Someone else changed the branding while this page was open. Reload to see the current values.
branding.failed: Could not save the branding. Nothing changed.
branding.fixedNotice: Status and priority colours are fixed and cannot be themed. They carry meaning — a resolved ticket has to look resolved to everyone, in every organisation — so a setting that could change them would let the product say the wrong thing about a ticket.
branding.refusedBy.text: No text colour is readable on it.
branding.refusedBy.hover: Its hover and pressed states are not readable.
branding.refusedBy.surface: It is too close to the page background.
